name: Pact Wizard (CR 1)
body:
PACT WIZARD
CR 1

Human abjurer (pact wizard) 1
CG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 11, touch 11, flat-footed 10 (+1 Dex)
hp 8 (1d6+2)
Fort +2, Ref +1, Will +4
Defensive Abilities protective ward 6/day (3 rounds, +1), resistance; Resist fire 5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee dagger +0 (1d4, 19-20)
Ranged dagger +1 (1d4, 19-20)
Wizard Spells Prepared (CL 1st, concentration +4)

1st Level–alarm, magic missile, protection from evil
0-Level–detect magic, ray of frost, read magic

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 12, Con 14, Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 12
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 11
Traits Avid Reader (Knowledge– arcana), Classically Schooled, Star Struck (The Noble Prince- Charisma); Drawbacks Dependent
Feats Careful Reader, Spell Focus (abjuration)
Skills Knowledge (arcana) +7, Knowledge (planes) +7, Knowledge (religion) +7, Linguistics +7, Profession (scribe) +6, Spellcraft +8
Languages Celestial, Common, Dwarven, Elven
SQ arcane bond (dagger), effortless magic, opposition schools (Illusion, Necromancy), patron spells (Mind)
Gear dagger (2 gp), tome of epics (50 gp), wizard’s kit (21 gp)
